prompt: A woman in a floor-length navy evening gown with long sleeves stands at a hotel ballroom entrance, adjusting the cuff at her wrist before stepping inside. The camera holds a static medium shot from the doorway, chandeliers and seated guests soft in the background. Her movement is unhurried and composed, the gown falling to the floor throughout.

A man in a charcoal three-piece suit buttons his jacket in front of a full-length mirror in a quiet dressing room, straightening his tie afterward. The camera holds a static medium shot from beside the mirror, wardrobe doors and a wooden chair visible behind him. His hands move with practiced ease, the suit fully covering him throughout.

A woman in a long-sleeved emerald dress and closed heels crosses a marble lobby toward a reception desk, her hem sweeping just above the floor. The camera holds a static wide shot from across the lobby, tall windows casting bright afternoon light. Her stride is steady and even, the scene calm and entirely ordinary.

A violinist in a black long-sleeved concert dress tunes her instrument on a dim stage before a performance, head tilted toward the strings. The camera holds a static medium shot from the front row, empty seats and music stands visible around her. Her adjustments are small and precise, the dress covering her to the ankle throughout.

A man in a tuxedo with a bow tie waits beside a car outside a theatre, checking his watch and glancing down the street. The camera holds a static medium shot from the curb, the theatre marquee glowing behind him in the evening. He shifts his weight once and settles, the scene quiet and unhurried.

A woman in jeans and a long-sleeved grey sweater browses a shelf in a secondhand bookshop, pulling out a volume and turning it over in her hands. The camera holds a static medium shot from the end of the aisle, warm lamplight and crowded shelves filling the frame. Her movements are slow and considered throughout.

A man in dark trousers and a plain crew-neck shirt with sleeves to the elbow makes coffee at a kitchen counter, pouring water slowly over a filter. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the counter, morning light through a window behind him. His attention stays on the pour, the scene domestic and calm.

A woman in corduroy trousers and a knitted turtleneck sits cross-legged on a rug, sorting photographs into small piles on the floor. The camera holds a static high-angle shot from above the rug, a sofa edge and bookshelf visible at the frame's border. Her hands move steadily between the piles, the room quiet.

A man in jeans and a flannel shirt buttoned to the collar waits at a bus stop in overcast light, hands in his pockets, watching the road. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the street, passing traffic blurred in the foreground. He shifts once and looks down the road again, the scene ordinary and unhurried.

A woman in long trousers and a long-sleeved striped shirt waters plants along a windowsill, tilting a small can over each pot in turn. The camera holds a static medium shot from inside the room, bright diffuse daylight through the glass. She works left to right without hurry, the scene domestic and plain.

A woman in a long wool coat and scarf walks along a city street in late autumn, leaves scattering ahead of her on the pavement. The camera holds a static medium shot level from the opposite kerb, shopfronts and parked cars behind her. Her pace is even and relaxed, the coat buttoned throughout.

A man in a padded winter jacket and gloves brushes snow from a car windscreen with a long-handled brush. The camera holds a static medium shot from the front of the car, a snow-covered street stretching away behind him. His strokes are broad and repetitive, breath visible in the cold air.

A woman in a belted trench coat stands under a shop awning waiting out a rain shower, watching the street and shifting her bag on her shoulder. The camera holds a static medium shot from inside the shop doorway, rain streaking the frame's edge. She adjusts the collar once, the scene calm.

A man in a hooded raincoat walks a dog along a wet park path, the lead loose in his gloved hand. The camera holds a static wide shot from the side of the path, leafless trees and puddles filling the background. Both move at an easy pace, the scene grey and ordinary.

A woman in a quilted anorak and hiking trousers adjusts the straps of a backpack at a trailhead sign, tightening each shoulder strap in turn. The camera holds a static medium shot from beside the sign, forest and a gravel path behind her. Her movements are brisk and practical throughout.

A nurse in full-length scrubs and a long-sleeved undershirt checks a chart at a ward station, turning a page and making a note. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the counter, corridor lighting and closed doors behind her. Her attention stays on the chart, the scene quiet and professional.

A chef in a white jacket and checked trousers plates a dish at a pass, wiping the rim with a cloth before sliding it forward. The camera holds a static medium shot from the far side of the pass, stainless steel and heat lamps framing the shot. His movements are quick and practiced throughout.

A mechanic in full coveralls zipped to the collar wipes her hands on a rag beside an open engine bay, then leans back in to check a fitting. The camera holds a static medium shot from the front of the car, a workshop's tool racks visible behind. Her movements are deliberate and unhurried.

A train conductor in a long-sleeved uniform jacket and cap walks the length of a carriage checking tickets, pausing at each row. The camera holds a static medium shot down the aisle, seated passengers soft in the background. His pace is steady, the scene routine and calm.

A florist in a long apron over a long-sleeved shirt trims stems at a workbench, laying each cut flower into a growing bundle. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the bench, buckets of blooms filling the background. Her hands work continuously and evenly throughout.

A close-up frames a man's face and shirt collar as he knots a tie, chin lifted slightly, the collar buttoned throughout. The camera holds a static close-up from just below eye level, a wardrobe mirror reflecting warm light behind him. He tightens the knot and lowers his chin, the movement practiced.

A close-up frames a woman's sleeve and forearm as she rolls a long cuff twice to the elbow, then smooths the fabric flat. The camera holds a static close-up at desk height, papers and a lamp out of focus beyond her arm. The motion is deliberate and repeated once, the scene quiet.

A close-up frames the shoulder and lapel of a man's overcoat as he lifts the collar against the wind, fabric filling most of the frame. The camera holds a static close-up from the side, a blurred street and grey sky behind. He holds the collar a moment then lets it fall, the movement small.

A close-up frames a woman's hands adjusting a scarf at her neck, winding it once more and tucking the end beneath her coat's collar. The camera holds a static close-up at neck height, a wooden door out of focus behind her. Her hands move slowly and finish in a settled position.

Two colleagues in long-sleeved office wear stand at a whiteboard discussing a diagram, one drawing an arrow while the other points. The camera holds a static wide shot from the back of the meeting room, empty chairs and a window behind them. Their gestures are unhurried and conversational throughout.

A family of four in coats and boots walks together along a canal path on a cold afternoon, the two children a step ahead of the parents. The camera holds a static wide shot from the opposite bank, leafless trees and moored boats behind them. Their pace is easy and even, the scene ordinary.

Three friends in jumpers and jeans sit around a kitchen table sharing a meal, passing a dish between them and talking. The camera holds a static wide shot from the end of the table, cupboards and a window soft in the background. The conversation is relaxed and continuous throughout.

Two hikers in full-length trousers and zipped fleeces stop at a ridge to check a paper map, one holding it open while the other traces a route. The camera holds a static wide shot from a few paces back, hills receding into haze behind them. Their movements are calm and deliberate.

A choir in long-sleeved robes stands in rows in a church, singing from folders held at chest height. The camera holds a static wide shot from the centre aisle, stone columns and stained glass behind them. Their posture stays steady, only the folders and their breathing moving.

A couple in winter coats and scarves stand close together on a railway platform, foreheads nearly touching as they talk before a train arrives. The camera holds a static medium shot from down the platform, departure boards glowing softly behind them. Their posture is affectionate and entirely modest, the conversation quiet.

Two people in formal wedding attire share a slow dance in a hall, her long-sleeved gown and his suit fully covering them as they turn. The camera holds a static wide shot from the edge of the floor, string lights and seated guests in soft focus. The turn is slow and continuous throughout.

A couple in long-sleeved knitwear sit side by side on a sofa under a shared blanket, watching something off-screen and occasionally laughing. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the room, a lamp and bookshelf framing them. Their movement is minimal and settled, the scene domestic.

An elderly couple in coats walk arm in arm through a park, matching each other's slow pace along a gravel path. The camera holds a static wide shot from the side of the path, autumn trees and a bench behind them. Their steps are even and unhurried, the mood companionable.

Two people in jumpers embrace goodbye at a front door, one stepping back and lifting a hand as the other stays in the doorway. The camera holds a static medium shot from the garden path, hallway light spilling out behind them. The gesture is brief, warm and entirely modest.

A woman in trousers and a long cardigan folds laundry on a bed, smoothing each item flat before adding it to a stack. The camera holds a static medium shot from the foot of the bed, a wardrobe and curtained window behind her. Her movements repeat steadily and without hurry, the room quiet.

A man in a long-sleeved shirt and jeans sits on the edge of a bed lacing his shoes, then stands and checks his pockets. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the bedroom, a made bed and bedside lamp in frame. His movements are ordinary and unhurried throughout.

A woman in a long dress and cardigan reads in an armchair beside a window, turning a page and shifting slightly in the seat. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the room, rain visible on the glass behind her. Her movement is minimal, the scene still and domestic.

A man in a jumper and trousers stacks plates into a cupboard in a small kitchen, reaching up and setting each one down carefully. The camera holds a static medium shot from the doorway, worktops and a kettle visible around him. The motion repeats evenly and calmly throughout.

A woman in a long-sleeved dress sits at a desk writing in a notebook by lamplight, pausing once to look up before continuing. The camera holds a static medium shot from beside the desk, a curtained window and shelves behind her. Her hand moves steadily across the page, the room quiet.
